beats.say: This question is about a curve, drawn only where X is greater than negative one.
asks: Why only x greater than negative one?

beats.say: Y equals C is a horizontal line, at height C. The question tells us it does not intersect the curve.
asks: Why is y = c a horizontal line?

beats.say: We must explain why C has to be at least four, by writing the fraction as A plus B over X plus one.
asks: Why write it in this form?

beats.say: To get that form, use long division: divide four X plus two by X plus one.
asks: Can I do it another way?

beats.say: Four X divided by X is four: that is the four on top. Four times X plus one is four X plus four.
asks: How do I know it goes in four times?

beats.say: Take it away: four X plus two, minus four X plus four, leaves negative two. That is the remainder.
So Y is four, plus the remainder over X plus one: Y equals four minus two over X plus one.
asks: Why is the remainder over x + 1?

beats.say: Comparing with the form, A is four, and B is negative two.
Whether Y is above or below four depends on the sign of this fraction.
asks: Why does the sign of the fraction matter?

beats.say: Since X is greater than negative one, X plus one is greater than zero.
Two over a positive number is positive, so two over X plus one is greater than zero.
asks: Why is 2 over a positive number positive?

beats.say: Times by negative one, and the sign flips: negative two over X plus one is less than zero.
So Y equals four minus two over X plus one: four take away a positive number, so less than four.
Think of the graph: the curve is always below the line Y equals four.
Y equals four is the asymptote: the curve gets close to it, but never touches it.
Now slide the line Y equals C down below four, say C equals one. Now it intersects the curve.
It goes down forever near X equals negative one, and rises close to four. So every line below four intersects it.
asks: Why does every line below 4 cut the curve?

beats.say: At C equals four, it still does not intersect: the curve never touches four. So C equals four is allowed.
Above four, it does not intersect either. So the line must be at four or above: C is greater than or equal to four.
